label: pass
title: README mentions `npm start` but there is no start script
body: The README says you can start the API with `npm start`, but package.json has no `start` script so the command fails with "Missing script: start". Add a start script that runs the server (src/server.js).
plan:
Add a 'start' npm script to package.json so README's npm start works. The script will run node src/server.js to start the server.
1. Add start script to package.json
requirements: Add a start script to package.json with value 'node src/server.js'
Do not change any other scripts or behavior
Ensure tests and other code are unchanged
summary:
Added a start npm script to package.json that runs node src/server.js. Verified by running the test suite (npm test). Tests show one pre-existing failing test unrelated to this change (divide by zero throws RangeError). Only package.json was modified.

Requirements:
1. R1: Added start script in package.json with value 'node src/server.js' (package.json)
2. R2: Did not change other scripts or behavior (package.json updated only)
3. R3: Tests and other code unchanged (ran npm test; existing failing test remains)
4. R4: Only package.json was modified (only package.json was updated)
patch:
diff --git a/package.json b/package.json
index 3e89e46..31ec720 100644
--- a/package.json
+++ b/package.json
@@ -5,6 +5,7 @@
   "type": "module",
   "main": "src/server.js",
   "scripts": {
+    "start": "node src/server.js",
     "test": "node --test"
   },
   "engines": {
verify: npm test --silent: exit before=1 after=1; no new test failures
